role: one-time held-out confirmation after development configuration freeze

selection.duplicate_policy: remove identical normalized gold SQL within each database
selection.sampling_policy: deterministic even sampling over local SQL complexity score
selection.sampling_note: complexity score is a local stratification heuristic, not official Spider hardness

schema_linking_configuration: Exp2 lexical Top-4 plus foreign-key paths
